opening: They saw me. All three of them. I watched a man die by the bridge stairs and they let me walk away. I don't intend to be here when they reconsider. First: a way out. And that damned travel restriction.
content_note: Original work. Dark comedy, alcohol references, and an off-screen murder. No generated speech or live AI connection.
goal: Read the travel notice, recover the window leaflet, and think through a provisional plan in the notebook.
